name: awaisjameel/laravel-starter-kit
description: The skeleton application for the Laravel framework focused on security and type safety.

dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74,#34d399" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --queue=realtime,high,default --tries=1" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "npm run dev" "php artisan reverb:start --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8080 --hostname=127.0.0.1 --no-interaction" --names=server,queue,logs,vite,reverb --kill-others
dev:ssr: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74,#34d399" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --queue=realtime,high,default --tries=1" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "php artisan inertia:start-ssr" "php artisan reverb:start --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8080 --hostname=127.0.0.1 --no-interaction" --names=server,queue,logs,ssr,reverb --kill-others
qa:check: npx concurrently -c "#c4b5fd,#93c5fd,#fb7185,#34d399" --group --names=php,format,lint,types "composer qa:php" "npm run format:check" "npm run lint:check" "npm run typecheck"

scripts-descriptions.dev: Start the local development stack (server, queue, logs, Vite, Reverb).
scripts-descriptions.dev:ssr: Start the development stack against the production SSR path.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Pest suite in parallel.
scripts-descriptions.test:serial: Run the Pest suite in a single process for debugging output.
scripts-descriptions.test:fast: Run the Pest suite in parallel, limited to impacted tests (needs pcov or Xdebug).
scripts-descriptions.format: Fix PHP code style with Pint.
scripts-descriptions.format:check: Report PHP code style violations without writing files.
scripts-descriptions.refactor:check: Report Rector refactorings without writing files.
scripts-descriptions.cleanup:php: Run the mutating PHP pipeline: Rector, Pint, then PHPStan.
scripts-descriptions.cleanup: Run the mutating PHP and frontend pipelines in parallel.
scripts-descriptions.qa:php: Run the non-mutating PHP checks: Rector dry-run, Pint test, then PHPStan.
scripts-descriptions.qa:check: Run every non-mutating PHP and frontend check in parallel.
scripts-descriptions.generate: Regenerate backend-owned contracts: module manifest, TypeScript types, Wayfinder helpers.
scripts-descriptions.generate-and-cleanup: Regenerate backend-owned contracts, then run the mutating cleanup pipelines.
